# relgap

relgap merges release notes across a version range into one digest (breaking changes
first, with source links), and reports toolchain drift, EOL and known vulnerabilities across
your repositories.

stdout carries data, stderr carries logs. Use --format json for scripting.

Docs: https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev.

## Usage

```sh
relgap <command>
```

The [global flags](/cli/global-flags) work with every command.

## Examples

```sh
relgap digest terraform 1.9.0..1.10.0
relgap outdated --fail-on breaking
relgap pins ~/src/infra
relgap drift ~/src/infra ~/src/apps
relgap audit ~/src/infra
```

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [relgap audit](/cli/audit) | List the known vulnerabilities of every pinned tool version, and the pins OSV can't check |
| [relgap cache](/cli/cache/) | Inspect or clear the HTTP cache |
| [relgap completion](/cli/completion) | Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell |
| [relgap config](/cli/config/) | Inspect and validate configuration |
| [relgap digest](/cli/digest) | Merge the release notes of every version in a range into one digest |
| [relgap drift](/cli/drift) | Show which repositories pin different versions of the same tool |
| [relgap mcp](/cli/mcp) | Serve digest, breaking\_changes, outdated, drift and resolve to an MCP client over stdio |
| [relgap notify](/cli/notify) | Publish saved digest, outdated, drift and audit reports as a GitHub pull request comment |
| [relgap outdated](/cli/outdated) | Compare every pinned tool version in a project with the latest release |
| [relgap pins](/cli/pins) | List the tool versions pinned in your repositories, with file and line |
| [relgap registry](/cli/registry/) | Check, test and update relgap registry entries |
| [relgap resolve](/cli/resolve) | Show how a tool name resolves to a repository, version rules and changelog sources |
| [relgap version](/cli/version) | Print version and build information |
